title: REQ · History list shows a loading state and remaining is derived from history
summary: Loading message while history loads; remaining count derived from loaded history entries
description: Context: no loading indicator exists while listMine is in flight. Desired behavior: a status message 'Loading your suggestions…' shows until listMine settles, after which the list and the remaining count (MAX_PER_PLAYER minus sent entries) render. Why: the player knows history is being fetched.
acceptance_criteria: Given listMine is pending, when the sheet opens, then an element with role status and text 'Loading your suggestions…' is visible
Given listMine resolves with 2 contributions, when loading ends, then the loading text is gone, both prompts are listed and 'Contributions left: 3' shows

preserve: Merge of history with in-flight entries
